00358:             override fun onMessage(webSocket: WebSocket, text: String) {
00359:                 Log.d("MeshFilesRecvRawText", "WS Text: $text")

00361:                     handleIncomingMessage(webSocket, text)
00362:                     return

00364:                 if (isProtocolJsonMessage(text)) {
00365:                     handleIncomingMessage(webSocket, text)
00366:                     processJsonControlMessage(text)
00367:                 } else {
00368:                     val activeDl = activeDownloads.values.firstOrNull()

00370:                         val chunkBytes = text.toByteArray(Charsets.UTF_8)
00371:                         activeDl.outputStream?.write(chunkBytes)
00372:                         activeDl.receivedBytes += chunkBytes.size
00373:                         _activeTransfers.value = _activeTransfers.value.map {
00374:                             if (it.filePath == activeDl.filePath) {
00375:                                 it.copy(
00376:                                     bytesTransferred = activeDl.receivedBytes,
00377:                                     totalBytes = if (activeDl.totalSize > 0) activeDl.totalSize else activeDl.receivedBytes
00378:                                 )
00379:                             } else {
00380:                                 it
00381:                             }
00382:                         }
00383:                         if (activeDl.totalSize > 0 && activeDl.receivedBytes >= activeDl.totalSize) {
00384:                             finishDownload(activeDl.filePath)
00385:                         } else if (activeDl.context != null) {
00386:                             updateDownloadNotification(

00400:                         } else {
00401:                             0.5f
00402:                         }

00404:                         if (readingTotalSize > 0 && readingReceivedBytes >= readingTotalSize) {
00405:                             finishReadingFile()

00413:             override fun onMessage(webSocket: WebSocket, bytes: ByteString) {

00415:                 val isJson = isProtocolJsonMessage(textCandidate)

00525:     private fun handleIncomingMessage(webSocket: WebSocket, text: String) {
00526:         Log.d("MeshFilesRecv", "Files WS Recv (${text.length} chars): $text")
00527:         if (text == "c" || text == "cr") {
00528:             _connectionState.value = true
00529:             onStateChanged?.invoke()
00530:             webSocket.send("5")
00531:
00532:             scope.launch {
00533:                 delay(200)
00534:                 val targetPath = _currentPath.value.ifEmpty { "/" }
00535:                 listDirectory(targetPath)
00536:             }
00537:         } else {
00538:             handleJsonMessage(text)
00539:         }
00540:     }
00541:
00542:     private fun processJsonControlMessage(text: String) {
00543:         if (!isProtocolJsonMessage(text)) return
00544:         try {
00545:             val json = gson.fromJson(text, JsonObject::class.java) ?: return
00546:             val action = json.get("action")?.asString ?: ""
00547:             val subaction = json.get("subaction")?.asString ?: ""
00548:
00549:             if (action == "zip" || action == "dialogmessage" || subaction == "zip" || json.has("zip")) {
00550:                 handleZipControlMessage(json)
00551:                 return
00552:             }
00553:
00554:             if (action == "downloadEnd" || subaction == "end" || subaction == "close" || subaction == "complete") {
00555:                 if (activeDownloads.isNotEmpty()) finishDownload()
00556:                 if (copyingSourcePath != null) finishCopyingFile()
00557:                 if (readingFilePath != null) finishReadingFile()
00558:                 return
00559:             }
00560:
00561:             if (action == "downloadStart" || subaction == "start") {
00562:                 val reqid = json.get("reqid")?.asString ?: json.get("id")?.asString ?: ""
00563:                 val size = json.get("size")?.asLong ?: 0L
00564:                 val activeDl = activeDownloads.values.firstOrNull()
00565:                 if (activeDl != null && size > 0) {
00566:                     activeDl.totalSize = size
00567:                 }
00568:                 val pullReq = JsonObject().apply {
00569:                     addProperty("action", "download")
00570:                     addProperty("subaction", "download")
00571:                     if (reqid.isNotEmpty()) {
00572:                         addProperty("reqid", reqid)
00573:                         addProperty("id", reqid)
00574:                     }
00575:                 }
00576:                 webSocket?.send(pullReq.toString())
00577:                 return
00578:             }
00579:
00580:             val data = json.get("data")?.asString
00581:                 ?: json.get("content")?.asString
00582:                 ?: json.get("text")?.asString
